hero_lead: Devmam Flourish Foods LLP mills fresh atta, maida & sooji at our new state-of-the-art unit in Chaubepur, Kanpur — 100% natural grain, ground the traditional chakki way, packed with modern hygiene under the Mamta Bhoj name.
about_title: A new mill, built on an old promise of purity
about_body1: Devmam Flourish Foods LLP operates a modern flour-milling unit at Chaubepur, Kanpur Nagar (Uttar Pradesh), set up to bring genuinely fresh, stone-ground atta to Indian kitchens — the same care that has always gone into flour ground on a home chakki, now backed by hygienic, quality-controlled processing.
about_body2: Every batch under our Mamta Bhoj brand starts with carefully sourced wheat, is naturally stone-ground to protect its fibre and nutrients, and is packed in a facility that meets ISO 9001:2015 and FSSAI standards — so what reaches your kitchen is close to what a chakki grinds at home.
quality_intro: Traditional stone-grinding, controlled at every stage to keep the process hygienic and the nutrition intact.
process1_body: Wheat is sourced and checked for quality before it enters the mill.
process2_body: Grain is cleaned and conditioned to remove impurities prior to grinding.
process3_body: Naturally chakki-ground to retain fibre, bran and natural nutrients.
process4_body: Sealed and labelled under ISO 9001:2015 & FSSAI-compliant conditions.
process5_body: Every batch is checked before packing, so only flour that meets our standard reaches the packing line.
process6_body: Sealed, labelled and dispatched fresh — ready for your rotis, parathas and everyday cooking.
contact_intro: Reach out for wholesale, distribution or dealership enquiries — our team responds within one business day.
